title: I-029 effective intent, forgetting, and compaction watermarks
clauseOfficialized: Declare/Supersede/Retract/RestoreIntentAsNew on an in-memory ledger. Retract and purge do not revive a superseded value. Purged bodies cannot be restored. expectedHeadSeq conflicts do not half-write. 1000 change/delete events revive 0 retired constraints. A watermark or privacy-epoch change makes a snapshot SNAPSHOT_STALE and requires rebuild. compile uses the reducer, not a chat summary. Already-uploaded provider bodies are reported as notSupported and never claimed globally erased. Ambiguous asset references are REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS and do not mutate the project. Chat-body purge leaves Project revision unchanged.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: I-029 was still planned. Increment 2.18 officialized I-028 ingest/projection only. There was no intent reducer, compaction watermark, or deletion barrier.
